stories.label: US Supreme Court strikes down tariffs; Trump invokes new authority
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down Trump's emergency tariffs 6-3. Trump invoked Section 122 for 10% global tariff and attacked justices as influenced by 'foreign interests'. Republicans privately celebrating. New legal challenges expected.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff and military buildup
stories.summary: ~8 days remain on Trump's ultimatum. Draft deal reportedly imminent but military buildup continues. UK blocked bases. US partners reportedly reluctant. Dual-track diplomacy and escalation. Oil above $72, Hormuz closed.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Mike Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates. Walked it back only as 'unrealistic,' not wrong. Unprecedented statement from a sitting US ambassador.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire fraying — strikes widen
stories.summary: Israeli strikes widening across Lebanon — at least 8 killed including drone attack on Ein el-Hilweh. Ceasefire eroding with each cycle. Hezbollah rejected disarmament. Pattern of escalation accelerating.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal stalls over farming safeguards
stories.summary: Europe legislating automatic safeguard mechanisms for agriculture while Argentina pushes to finalise the deal. Decades-long negotiation hitting familiar protectionist barriers. Trump tariff chaos adding urgency for both sides.

stories.label: Record 37-day rainfall devastates western France
stories.summary: 37 consecutive days of rain — record-breaking — have caused disastrous flooding in western France. Entire villages isolated. Climate-linked extreme precipitation event.

stories.label: North Korea party congress — succession and military doctrine
stories.summary: Kim Ju-ae conspicuously absent from rare party congress. Raises questions about succession plans. Congress formalising military doctrine with ICBM implications. Kim touting economic achievements.

stories.label: GGML/llama.cpp creator joins Hugging Face
stories.summary: Georgi Gerganov's GGML — creator of llama.cpp, the most used local AI inference engine — joining Hugging Face. Consolidates open-source AI ecosystem: inference engine meets model hub.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecating Archive.today and removing links after evidence the service executed DDoS attacks and altered stored web captures. Trust in web archiving undermined.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint letter to UAE national security advisor over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC. Letter shared with Washington. Gulf rift now a three-way geopolitical issue.

stories.label: Trump pursues Saudi nuclear deal with enrichment path
stories.summary: US negotiating nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia that would allow enrichment — while demanding Iran end enrichment. Major proliferation risk.

stories.label: Hungary blocks €90B EU loan to Ukraine over Russian oil
stories.summary: Hungary threatening to veto €90B EU loan to Ukraine after Kyiv halted Russian oil transit. EU internal fracture over Russia policy.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: US creating 'Tech Corps' to counter Chinese AI exports. India summit concluded with US rejecting governance. UN announced science-led AI panel. Competition extends from chips to global adoption.

stories.label: NASA targets March for Artemis II crewed Moon mission
stories.summary: NASA targeting early March for Artemis II — first crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972.

stories.label: FT exposes $90B Russian oil sanctions evasion network
stories.summary: FT investigation reveals shell company network exporting $90B in sanctioned Russian oil.

stories.label: Mass killings in northwestern Nigeria
stories.summary: 50+ killed and women/children abducted in Zamfara. NW Nigeria security crisis worsening despite US military advisory deployment.

stories.label: Senegal doubles prison terms for homosexuality
stories.summary: Senegal approved bill doubling prison terms and raising fines for homosexual acts. Part of broader African trend.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea tensions as peace deal frays
stories.summary: Pretoria peace deal fraying. Eritrea hasn't withdrawn. Tigray reconstruction stalled.

stories.label: China routing drones to Russia via Thailand
stories.summary: China using Thailand as transit point to ship drones to Russia, circumventing sanctions.

stories.label: China's gallium grip ahead of Trump Beijing visit
stories.summary: China controls ~80% of global gallium/germanium supply. Export control deadline looming.

stories.label: SEC reclassifies stablecoin holdings for broker-dealers
stories.summary: SEC allowed broker-dealers to treat stablecoins as capital under 'Project Crypto'. Shift from enforcement to enablement.

stories.label: France confirms military trainers in DR Congo
stories.summary: France acknowledged military personnel in DRC after social media images. Great power positioning in Africa's largest active war zone.

stories.label: Sudan genocide assessment and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: UN crossed 'hallmarks of genocide' threshold. RSF drone attacks and child soldier recruitment continue. Saudi-UAE rift complicates response.

stories.label: Trump Board of Peace for Gaza and US military base
stories.summary: Board of Peace inaugural meeting held. $7B pledged. Indonesia commits 8,000 troops. US planning 5,000-person base at Rafah.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Talks stalled. No new round announced. Focus shifted to Iran crisis.

stories.label: South Korea Yoon martial law verdict
stories.summary: Yoon sentenced to life. KOSPI hit record 5,800. Appeal expected.

stories.label: Personalized mRNA cancer vaccine shows durable immunity
stories.summary: Nature paper: personalized mRNA vaccines produce durable T cell immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.

stories.label: Hamas holds vote for new interim leader
stories.summary: Hamas conducting internal vote for new interim leader. Significant governance shift.

stories.label: China overtakes US as Germany's top trading partner
stories.summary: Germany's trade center of gravity shifted to Beijing. Driven by US tariff disruptions.
